race.comment: SEEYOU RAIDER (2) would be a popular winner of this race, being trained by the sister of the late Ricky Thompson, after whom the race is named. Hasn't won in two starts at 1600m, but is a son of Rebel Raider and was good winning over 1479m a couple back and not everything went his way last time out. Six starts here have realised two wins and two second placings. JENNI YOU THINK (11) is a model of consistency who doesn't need a lot to go right to be a force, but will need luck from the draw. MIKE'S HOPE (12) hasn't raced since Oct 20, but was good in a recent trial and looks poised to continue the good recent form. TILL QUEEN (7) made a nice return in a handy BM66 at Warrnambool and is suited by the step up to 1600m, at which she is 2 from 2. BLAZING SWORD (1) was ultra-consistent before the last start flop, so warrants another chance.
